summary: Google Products flicker is not confirmed or cleared by frame-by-frame pixel evidence (QA-002).
evidence: docs/qa-test-plan.md §QA-002: prior PNG hashes changed for both target and static control; controlled pixel comparison is still missing.

summary: <select> was focusable but immovable: arrow/Home/End scrolled the page instead of changing the option, so no form with a select was usable by keyboard.
evidence: BR-101. Proof of the old state and the fix: docs/tasks/TASK-030-SELECT-INTERACTION.md §2 (internal/engine/focus.go:573-590 had no select, cmd/goosie/interaction.go fell through to scrollContentKey) and §9.3 (six behaviour-off mutations, each killing a test).

summary: No constraint validation before submit: a form with an empty required field or a malformed email/number submits and sends the bad value.
evidence: BR-105. internal/engine/engine.go:1619 submitFormLocked dispatches submit then collects and sends with zero validation; method=dialog is handled at engine.go:1631-1641 so the check must precede it. Spec: docs/tasks/TASK-031-FORM-SUBMISSION-CORRECTNESS.md §2.

summary: The submitter button is dropped: its name/value pair is never added and implicit submit cannot tell which button fired.
evidence: BR-107. internal/engine/forms.go:70-72 and :88 isSuccessfulControl skips buttons claiming they are handled separately, but nothing handles them: engine.go:1560-1568 runClickDefault and focus.go:378 Enter-submit both call SubmitForm(form) with no submitter argument.

summary: <select> has no node in the accessibility tree, so an assistive user cannot see or operate the control at all - even though TASK-030 made it keyboard-operable.
evidence: BR-139. Measured while writing the BR-101 journey: the layout arena carries obj tag="select" id="sel", Session.AccessibilityTree() under the form returns only role=4 id="send"; cmd/goosie clickNode therefore cannot address a select (journey uses clickElementByID). Recorded in docs/tasks/TASK-030-SELECT-INTERACTION.md §9.4.

summary: ::first-letter and ::first-line are not supported, so a drop cap collapses to normal text and the paragraphs below shift up.
evidence: BR-075. Found by TASK-027: three blank bands remain in testdata/render/parity selectors/03-pseudo-elements.png at rows (457,475) (539,554) (579,599); ::before/::after content in the same fixture renders, so the residual is the missing first-letter/first-line support, not glyph coverage. docs/tasks/TASK-027-GLYPH-COVERAGE.md §6.

summary: Colour emoji still draw as tofu: golang.org/x/image/font/opentype does not read sbix/COLR tables.
evidence: TASK-027 killed 8 of the 9 blank bands in unicode/02-emoji-symbols.png; the remaining band at rows (451,470) is Chromium's Apple Color Emoji line box (~26px) versus Goosie's 18px tofu line, i.e. cumulative vertical drift, not a missing glyph. Note added to docs/roadmap-v2.md.

summary: TestNativeEndToEndPlaysARealVideo is load-sensitive: under a busy machine it can time out, which risks a false red in the sweep's gate step.
evidence: test/engine/media_native_test.go:264. Observed while running full suites in parallel worktrees; TASK-029 §3 forbids raising the timeout as a fix, so it is recorded here instead.
